description: Structured plans only; older free-text plans cannot be previewed. Preview a revision without using it: what would change, which checked shots would be cleared, and whether it still fits. For example constraintUpdates.availableMinutes: 30 answers "what if I only had 30 minutes?". Never uses the included revision. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderReference also works. Connections see only their own live or owner-test plans.

structuredChanges.description: Structured plans only: typed changes that stay within the plan's scope.

repeatable.description: Whether this key moment can be filmed again. A one-time live moment cannot be switched to repeatable.
